guidance.bestFor: The bare minimum: an outline text Button and a single line hint, Add to library, opening on the default top side

whenNotToUse.when: Several icon buttons in a row whose labels open with no delay as the pointer moves along

guidance.bestFor: A 3 column grid of 6 outline buttons, one per placement, including the 2 logical sides that follow text direction
agentNotes: Keep 1 entry of `sides` and pass it as `side`; the radix twin's list drops `inline-start` and `inline-end`, which only the base twin accepts

guidance.bestFor: A ghost info button with no visible text, named by its aria-label, opening a centered line of help copy

whenNotToUse.when: An icon button label that also needs to show its keyboard shortcut

guidance.bestFor: A small outline save icon button whose hint pairs the action name with its key in a Kbd cap
agentNotes: The save `Button` has no handler and nothing listens for the S key its `Kbd` shows; wire both to your save action

name: c-tooltip-5
title: Tooltip on notification bell with badge count
label: Bell With Count
description: Tooltip on notification bell with badge count

guidance.bestFor: An icon button with a destructive count Badge that opens a 3 item activity digest under a header and a View all link
agentNotes: The 3 activity lines, the counts in both `Badge` elements and the View all `href` are placeholders; feed them from your notifications

whenNotToUse.when: A bell with an unread dot and a one line summary of new items

guidance.bestFor: A System Status button whose hint lists 3 services with Operational or Degraded badges and an updated time
agentNotes: API and Database both read Operational but take success and info `Badge` variants; give each status 1 `variant` when you map real data

whenNotToUse.when: One service state that stays on screen without hovering a trigger

guidance.bestFor: A check mark set inside a sentence after Verified domain, revealing a Verified badge and a one line explanation
agentNotes: `TooltipTrigger` wraps only an aria-hidden icon and has no aria-label, so screen readers announce an unnamed button

whenNotToUse.when: A standalone icon button that opens help text, outside any sentence

guidance.bestFor: Bold, italic, underline and image buttons in one ghost toolbar, each named by aria-label, under a single provider
agentNotes: The 4 `Button` controls have no handlers and no pressed state; wire them to your editor commands

whenNotToUse.when: Bold, italic and underline controls that must show which ones are on

guidance.bestFor: A triangle alert icon button whose hint warns, behind a matching glyph, that the action cannot be undone
agentNotes: `Badge` is imported but never rendered, so lint flags an unused import; remove it when you copy the file

whenNotToUse.when: A destructive step that needs a confirmation before it runs

name: c-tooltip-10
title: Tooltip with feature badge and upgrade link
label: Upgrade Prompt
description: Tooltip with feature badge and upgrade link

guidance.bestFor: A lock icon button opening a Pro tagged feature pitch with a short blurb and an Upgrade to Pro button
agentNotes: The Upgrade to Pro `Button` has no handler; point it at your checkout or plans page

whenNotToUse.when: An upsell whose upgrade action must be reachable from the keyboard

name: c-tooltip-11
title: Tooltip with avatar and role badge
label: Avatar Role Badge
description: Tooltip with avatar and role badge

guidance.bestFor: An avatar trigger that opens the same photo with the person's name, an Admin role badge and an email address
agentNotes: `AvatarFallback` reads SC for Emma Wilson in both places; derive the initials from the user's name
The photo URL and alt text repeat in both `AvatarImage` elements; read them and the email from one user record

whenNotToUse.when: A fuller profile preview with a large photo, handle and join date

name: c-tooltip-12
title: Tooltip on disabled button with wrapper
label: Disabled Button
description: Tooltip on disabled button with wrapper

guidance.bestFor: A disabled Delete Project button wrapped in a span trigger, so the reason it is locked still shows on hover
agentNotes: The `span` trigger is not focusable and the disabled `Button` skips Tab, so keyboard users never see the reason; give the span tabIndex 0

guidance.bestFor: An avatar with a green presence dot whose hint repeats the photo beside the name and an Online now line
agentNotes: Presence is a fixed `bg-green-500` dot and the words Online now; switch both from your presence data

whenNotToUse.when: A row of people whose presence shows as a dot with no details on demand

name: c-tooltip-14
title: Tooltip with file info and badges
label: File Info
description: Tooltip with file info and badges

guidance.bestFor: A muted file name in text that opens its size, upload age and PDF and Verified tags next to a document glyph
agentNotes: The file name, 2.4 MB, the upload age and both `Badge` labels are hardcoded; bind them to your file metadata

guidance.bestFor: A compact 3 labels count with a tag glyph that expands into 3 colored chips under a Labels heading
agentNotes: The 3 labels text and the Bug, Frontend and High Priority `Badge` chips are separate literals; derive the count from your label list

whenNotToUse.when: Labels that should stay visible on the row rather than behind a count

guidance.bestFor: A ghost bell button with an unread dot whose hint gives the new count above a View all link
agentNotes: The View all `href` is # and 3 new notifications is fixed text; point the link at your inbox and bind the count

whenNotToUse.when: A numbered count on the trigger with the latest items listed in the hint
